title: DANGER The battery exploded through the side.
text: DANGER The battery exploded through the side.. This lamp has a defect that could have been extremely dangerous for my grandchildren. The battery burst through the side of this thick plastic. I doubt it was due to the batteries. They were new and the other 2 were fine. Its now past the return date. Beware. My first review was 4 stars only because it was a lot smaller than expected.
